description: If every input equation has its endpoints in finite \(S\), then its saturation stage \(|S|^2\) is fixed by the saturation step.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure_fixed.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.step S (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S E) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S E
